SELECT COUNT(*) FROM article a WHERE a.status = 1 AND a.category_id = #{q.categoryId}
AND (a.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%') OR a.summary LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%'))

SELECT a.id, a.title, a.summary, a.cover, a.category_id, c.name AS category_name, a.author_id, u.nickname AS author_name, a.top, a.view_count, a.like_count, a.favorite_count, a.comment_count, a.publish_time FROM article_tag at JOIN article a ON a.id = at.article_id AND a.status = 1 LEFT JOIN user u ON u.id = a.author_id LEFT JOIN category c ON c.id = a.category_id WHERE at.tag_id = #{tagId} ORDER BY a.top DESC, a.publish_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM article_tag at JOIN article a ON a.id = at.article_id WHERE at.tag_id = #{tagId} AND a.status = 1
SELECT a.*, c.name AS category_name, u.nickname AS author_name FROM article a LEFT JOIN category c ON c.id = a.category_id LEFT JOIN user u ON u.id = a.author_id WHERE a.id = #{id}
SELECT c.id, c.name, c.sort, COUNT(a.id) AS article_count FROM category c LEFT JOIN article a ON a.category_id = c.id AND a.status = 1 GROUP BY c.id, c.name, c.sort ORDER BY c.sort ASC
SELECT t.id, t.name, COUNT(at.article_id) AS article_count FROM tag t LEFT JOIN article_tag at ON at.tag_id = t.id GROUP BY t.id, t.name ORDER BY article_count DESC

SELECT a.id, a.title, a.summary, a.cover, a.category_id, c.name AS category_name, a.author_id, u.nickname AS author_name, a.top, a.view_count, a.like_count, a.favorite_count, a.comment_count, a.publish_time FROM article a LEFT JOIN user u ON u.id = a.author_id LEFT JOIN category c ON c.id = a.category_id WHERE a.category_id = #{categoryId} AND a.status = 1 AND a.id != #{id} ORDER BY a.view_count DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT a.id, a.title, a.summary, a.cover, a.category_id, c.name AS category_name, a.author_id, u.nickname AS author_name, a.top, a.view_count, a.like_count, a.favorite_count, a.comment_count, a.publish_time FROM article a JOIN article_tag at ON at.article_id = a.id LEFT JOIN user u ON u.id = a.author_id LEFT JOIN category c ON c.id = a.category_id WHERE at.tag_id = #{tagId} AND a.status = 1 AND a.id != #{id} ORDER BY a.view_count DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT a.id, a.title, a.summary, a.cover, a.category_id, c.name AS category_name, a.author_id, u.nickname AS author_name, a.top, a.view_count, a.like_count, a.favorite_count, a.comment_count, a.publish_time, a.status FROM article a LEFT JOIN user u ON u.id = a.author_id LEFT JOIN category c ON c.id = a.category_id WHERE a.id IN #{id}

SELECT id, title, summary, content_md, view_count, like_count, favorite_count, comment_count FROM article WHERE status = 1 AND MATCH(title, content_md) AGAINST(#{query} IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) ORDER BY MATCH(title, content_md) AGAINST(#{query} IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC LIMIT #{limit}
